_about: The self-recall count for the reader's honors-or-lab rule (VARIANT_TITLE and variant_mix in kb/_course_outcomes_read.py) and for row_code (kb/_course_outline_index.py), over the 20 course outline indexes committed by S691 (indexes), every one but the superseded builds named below; an index committed later is not counted until a person judges its shared codes and adds it (S691's second reader, finding 2). A shared code is one index code holding two or more courses with reports. Each was judged by eye from its titles: variant, a course and its honors or lab version, which the rule must leave unread; different, two or more unrelated courses, which the title rule cannot tell apart and reads as one course retitled (the known gap, named here; HOND 045 alone is caught, by folded_pair from its records' two printed codes); every other shared code is one course retitled, which the rule must read. tests/ccsf_outcomes_only_test.py check 7 recomputes every count from the indexes and fails on any difference.
